title: Question cards
subject: Arabic
source: Seeded from arabic/y6 lesson 3 (Pupil PDF worksheet: question cards)
intro: Lesson 3: Asking questions: مَاذَا، لِمَاذَا، كَيْفَ. To understand how to ask and answer questions with what, why and how

cards:
هَلْ (hal)
a yes or no question word
blocks.task: use them to test yourself or a partner.

questions.a: For example: أُسَاعِدُهَا فِي المَطْبَخِ / أُنَظِّفُ غُرْفَتِي
questions.model: Teacher: كَيْفَ asks how. Answer with what you do: أُسَاعِدُهَا فِي المَطْبَخِ (I help her in the kitchen).

questions.q: Question cards on the pupil PDF: write three questions about the dialogue (one each with مَاذَا، لِمَاذَا، كَيْفَ); swap with a partner in a breakout and answer each other's in Arabic.
questions.a: Three well-formed questions and full-sentence answers, the why answer with لِأَنَّ
questions.model: Teacher writes: مَاذَا تَطْبُخُ أُمُّ يُوسُفَ؟ تَطْبُخُ الفَطُورَ.

questions.q: answer هَلْ تُسَاعِدُ أُمَّكَ؟ with a full sentence.
ask a question with كَيْفَ about school.
questions.a: For example: كَيْفَ تَذْهَبُ إِلَى المَدْرَسَةِ؟

questions.q: Back to our ponder: which question word teaches the most?
